description: Explains a GemmeinError code (err.code: conflict, forbidden, unknown_collection, invalid_shape, html_not_allowed, …): what the code means and the exact next step — including whether the refusal is final (a forbidden repeats on retry; the approach changes, not the request). Parsed from the installed API reference, so codes match the SDK version the app runs. With no code it lists every stable code.

code.description: the err.code to explain; omit to list all

name: explain_error
title: Explain error
